source.author_body: If I want $10k MRR by April, how many people do I actually have to talk to? I did the maths properly for once, instead of dividing by my price and feeling good. $10k at $29 a month is 345 customers. Fine. But about 5% of customers cancel every month. So over six months I don't win 345, I win 391. 46 of them only replace people who left. That's 16 new paying customers every single week. If 1 in 10 sales conversations becomes a customer (a guess, I don't know my real rate yet), that's 160 conversations a week. 32 a day, every weekday, starting Monday, for six months. I've never come close. At $99 it drops to 50 a week. Price fixes more of this than effort does. I put the sum in a free calculator so you can run yours: https://kasspian.com/tools/mrr-target-planner (I built it. It's part of Kasspian. No sign-up.) What's your real conversation-to-customer rate? Mine's a guess, and the whole plan hangs on it.

metadata.headline: $10k MRR needs 32 sales conversations a day. I've never had a single day like that.

source.decision: Discussion/seller/product research only; no paid buyer or complete competition/contact evidence
